commands.expected_revision_contract: taskControlRequest.expected_version MUST equal task_runs.revision; taskRunTransition.previous_revision MUST equal the prior revision and revision MUST advance by exactly one on a committed transition; see TS-001…TS-007.
commands.deadline_cancellation_contract: taskControlRequest.deadline bounds acceptance/processing; pause/cancel are pending until a documented safe point; any dispatched/unknown operation must be reconciled before the task is reported cancelled; see TS-004 and TS-007.
commands.side_effect_contract: Scheduler control itself has no direct external side effect. Task-owned operations retain independent operation/attempt state; dispatched or unknown effects require reconciliation before terminal cancellation.
